epics.subject: Crowd Monitoring System
epics.description: Development of real-time crowd monitoring functions for Brisbane Riverfire 2026.

epics.subject: Safety Alert Management
epics.description: System for generating alerts during overcrowding and emergency situations.

epics.subject: Emergency Communication Dashboard
epics.description: Dashboard for communication between safety officers and event management.

epics.subject: System Testing and Deployment

user_stories.subject: Real-time crowd monitoring
user_stories.description:
As a safety officer, I want to monitor crowd density in real time so that I can identify overcrowded areas and respond quickly to safety risks.

Value: 2500
Effort: 8

Acceptance Criteria:

- The dashboard displays live crowd density data
- Overcrowded areas are highlighted automatically
- Crowd information refreshes in real time
- Safety officers receive alerts when crowd limits are exceeded
- Data is displayed correctly on desktop and mobile devices

user_stories.subject: System integration testing
user_stories.description:
As an IT administrator, I want the crowd monitoring system to be fully tested before deployment so that the platform operates reliably during the Riverfire event.

Value: 2600
Effort: 7

Acceptance Criteria:

All modules are tested successfully.
System errors are identified and resolved.
The dashboard performs correctly under heavy traffic.
Security vulnerabilities are checked before deployment.
The final system is approved for production use.

user_stories.subject: Emergency alert notifications
user_stories.description:
As a safety officer, I want emergency alerts to be sent instantly so that visitors and staff can respond quickly during emergencies.

Value: 2200
Effort: 5

Acceptance Criteria:

Emergency alerts can be triggered manually.
Notifications are sent to all connected users.
Alerts display emergency instructions clearly.
The system records alert history.
Alerts are delivered within a few seconds.

user_stories.subject: Emergency evacuation guidance
user_stories.description:
As an event visitor, I want emergency evacuation instructions to appear instantly so that I can leave dangerous areas safely.

Value: 2100
Effort: 5

Acceptance Criteria:
Evacuation instructions appear instantly.
Emergency exits are displayed clearly.
Notifications are sent to connected devices.
Instructions remain visible during high traffic.
The system supports mobile and desktop devices.

user_stories.subject: Visitor check-in analytics
user_stories.description:
As an event coordinator, I want to view visitor check-in analytics so that I can monitor entry patterns during the event.

Value: 1800
Effort: 3

Acceptance Criteria:

• The system records visitor check-in times
• Entry statistics are displayed on the dashboard
• Peak entry periods are identified automatically
• Data updates in near real time
• Analytics can be viewed on desktop and mobile devices

user_stories.subject: Emergency communication dashboard
user_stories.description:
As an emergency coordinator, I want a central communication dashboard so that I can monitor incidents and coordinate responses efficiently.

Value: 2400
Effort: 6

Acceptance Criteria:

The dashboard displays live incident updates.
Emergency staff can send announcements through the dashboard.
Communication logs are stored securely.
The dashboard supports desktop and mobile access.
System response time remains stable during high traffic.

user_stories.subject: Crowd heatmap visualization
user_stories.description:
As a safety officer, I want crowd density to be displayed as a heatmap so that I can quickly identify dangerous overcrowded areas.

Value: 2300
Effort: 6

Acceptance Criteria:

Heatmaps display crowd density accurately.
High-risk areas are highlighted automatically.
Heatmap refreshes every few seconds.
The visualization works on desktop and mobile devices.
System performance remains stable during large events.

issues.subject: Notification API response timeout
issues.description:
The notification API occasionally takes too long to respond during heavy traffic simulations.

Likelihood:
High — high traffic can overload API requests.

Impact:
High — delayed notifications may affect emergency communication.

Control:
Monitor API response times during stress testing.

Mitigation:
Implement API optimisation and load balancing techniques.

issues.subject: Mobile dashboard layout overlap
issues.description:
Some dashboard elements overlap on smaller mobile screens during testing.

Likelihood:
Medium — mobile devices use different screen resolutions.

Impact:
Medium — users may not be able to view important crowd information properly.

Control:
Perform responsive design testing across multiple devices.

Mitigation:
Improve mobile UI responsiveness and adjust layout scaling.

issues.subject: Emergency alert sound delay
issues.description:
Audio emergency alerts are delayed by several seconds after activation.

Likelihood:
Medium — network latency may affect alert delivery speed.

Impact:
Medium — delayed alerts may reduce response effectiveness during emergencies.

Control:
Test alert timing under different network conditions.

Mitigation:
Improve notification delivery optimisation and reduce audio processing delay.

issues.subject: High server resource usage during peak traffic
issues.description:
Server CPU and memory usage increase significantly during large crowd simulations.

Likelihood:
High — thousands of users may access the dashboard during Riverfire.

Impact:
High — system slowdown may affect real-time monitoring performance.

Control:
Monitor server performance continuously during testing.

Mitigation:
Upgrade server resources and optimise backend processing.

issues.subject: Incorrect crowd count synchronization
issues.description:
Crowd numbers displayed on the dashboard do not always match the sensor data during testing.

Likelihood:
Medium — synchronization problems may occur when multiple sensors send data simultaneously.

Impact:
High — inaccurate crowd information may affect safety decisions.

Control:
Validate incoming sensor data before updating the dashboard.

Mitigation:
Implement automated data consistency checks and monitoring tools.

issues.subject: Heatmap loading performance issue
issues.description:
The crowd heatmap takes longer to load when crowd density increases significantly.

Likelihood:
Medium — visual processing demand may increase during peak crowd activity.

Impact:
Medium — slower heatmap updates may reduce monitoring efficiency.

Control:
Optimise heatmap rendering and database queries.

Mitigation:
Use caching techniques and reduce unnecessary graphical processing.

issues.subject: Emergency notifications not appearing on mobile devices
issues.description:
The crowd monitoring dashboard refreshes slower than expected during high traffic simulation.

Likelihood:
High — large crowd events may overload the system during peak periods.

Impact:
High — delayed updates may prevent safety officers from responding quickly to dangerous crowd situations.

Control:
Improve server optimisation and reduce unnecessary background processes.

Mitigation:
Perform load testing and implement performance monitoring before deployment.
